failure.body:
#### Description

xcvrd crashes due to PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-common/pull/397.

In this PR, it added a new line:

```python
self.vdm_dict = self.get_vdm(self.vdm.VDM_REAL_VALUE)
```

However, `self.vdm` might be None due to this line: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-common/blob/2606cd5fb0a58fc956577602235a9f8f84a887c6/sonic_platform_base/sonic_xcvr/api/public/cmis.py#L31

So, if the CMIS cable is flat memory, the call to "self.vdm.VDM_REAL_VALUE" always crashes:

```
Mar 25 <IPV6>.777905 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Exception occured at DomInfoUpdateTask thread due to AttributeError("'NoneType' object has no attribute 'VDM_REAL_VALUE'")
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779557 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Traceback (most recent call last):
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779616 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 1744, in run
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779616 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     self.task_worker()
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779616 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 1716, in task_worker
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779633 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     post_port_dom_info_to_db(logical_port_name, self.port_mapping, self.xcvr_table_helper.get_dom_tbl(asic_index), self.task_stopping_event, dom_info_cache=dom_info_cache)
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779644 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 627, in post_port_dom_info_to_db
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     dom_info_dict = _wrapper_get_transceiver_dom_info(physical_port)
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 279, in _wrapper_get_transceiver_dom_info
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     return platform_chassis.get_sfp(physical_port).get_transceiver_bulk_status()
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/sonic_platform_base/sonic_xcvr/sfp_optoe_base.py", line 32, in get_transceiver_bulk_status
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     return api.get_transceiver_bulk_status() if api is not None else None
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/sonic_platform_base/sonic_xcvr/api/public/cmis.py", line 233, in get_transceiver_bulk_status
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779816 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     self.vdm_dict = self.get_vdm(self.vdm.VDM_REAL_VALUE)
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779816 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'VDM_REAL_VALUE'
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779816 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Xcvrd: exception found at child thread DomInfoUpdateTask due to AttributeError("'NoneType' object has no attribute 'VDM_REAL_VALUE'")
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779827 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Exiting main loop as child thread raised exception!
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Insert a CMIS cable which has flat memory
2. Start sonic
3. Check syslog, you will see the crash in short

#### Describe the results you received:

```
Mar 25 <IPV6>.777905 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Exception occured at DomInfoUpdateTask thread due to AttributeError("'NoneType' object has no attribute 'VDM_REAL_VALUE'")
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779557 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd: Traceback (most recent call last):

Mar 25 <IPV6>.779644 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 627, in post_port_dom_info_to_db
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     dom_info_dict = _wrapper_get_transceiver_dom_info(physical_port)
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/xcvrd/xcvrd.py", line 279, in _wrapper_get_transceiver_dom_info
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     return platform_chassis.get_sfp(physical_port).get_transceiver_bulk_status()
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/sonic_platform_base/sonic_xcvr/sfp_optoe_base.py", line 32, in get_transceiver_bulk_status
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     return api.get_transceiver_bulk_status() if api is not None else None
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779784 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:   File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/dist-packages/sonic_platform_base/sonic_xcvr/api/public/cmis.py", line 233, in get_transceiver_bulk_status
Mar 25 <IPV6>.779816 sonic ERR pmon#xcvrd:     self.vdm_dict = self.get_vdm(self.vdm.VDM_REAL_VALUE)

No crashes

```
